Launching August 21st!

Step into the war torn world of Ezura!  The world where traditional gaming meets web3 ownership.  Swords of Blood offers an exciting blend of fun first game play, with it's fast paced hack-n-slash style and the added bonus of real ownership of your items through NFTs.
